title: HouseholdSnapshot
description: A whole household at one moment: version 2 of the Personal Economy Saver household schema. Version 2 adds memory, canvases and journal to version 1, in the export only.

homeCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example JPY or USD.

today.description: The household's own date, including a demo household's scenario date.

bankBalanceMinor.description: The bank balance the user typed in, in `homeCurrency`.

paypalBalanceMinor.description: The household's PayPal connection balances added up and converted to `homeCurrency` at `usdRateMicro`; 0 with no connection. Total cash is this plus `bankBalanceMinor`, before money set aside in pots.

usdRateMicro.description: Home currency per 1 USD scaled by 1e6, the rate the household's money state uses today (1000000 when `homeCurrency` is USD).

usdRateDate.description: The day `usdRateMicro` is from; null when `homeCurrency` is USD.

splitSince.description: The day the household got its second member and shared costs began to be split; null while it has one member.

shareBp.description: Share of the household's shared bills and charges, in basis points (4000 = 40%). The members' shares total 10000.

memberId.description: Whose card; null = a household card.

closingDay.description: Day of the month the statement closes; 31 = month end.

dueDay.description: Day of the following month the statement is paid from the bank.

anyOf.description: Integer minor units: whole yen for JPY, cents for USD. Negative means owed or out.

limitMinor.description: Integer minor units: whole yen for JPY, cents for USD. Negative means owed or out.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example JPY or USD.

amountMinor.description: Integer minor units: whole yen for JPY, cents for USD. Negative means owed or out.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example JPY or USD.

amountMinor.description: As the card issuer bills it, in `currency`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example JPY or USD.

anyOf.description: Integer minor units: whole yen for JPY, cents for USD. Negative means owed or out.

originalAmountMinor.description: When paid in another currency: the amount in `originalCurrency`.

anyOf.description: ISO 4217 code, for example JPY or USD.

originalCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example JPY or USD.

anyOf.description: An exchange rate scaled by 1e6: units of the home currency per 1 USD, or original to billed currency.

fxRateMicro.description: An exchange rate scaled by 1e6: units of the home currency per 1 USD, or original to billed currency.

date.description: A calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: pending = waiting in To check; it counts for nothing until the user confirms it.

shared.description: true = split between the members by their shares; the owner of the card paid it.

category.description: One of the fourteen fixed categories; the key, not the label.

businessBp.description: The business share in basis points: 0 = personal, 10000 = business, between = mixed (3000 = 30% business). Categories and shares move no money.

madeBy.description: Who made the row: form = typed in or confirmed in the app, ask = the in-app assistant, mcp = a connected assistant, reader = read from a document, cron = the daily job, paypal = PayPal, import = an import.

paidByMemberId.description: Who pays a shared bill, at every occurrence of a repeating one; the bill is split between the members only when this is set. Null otherwise.

anyOf.description: Integer minor units: whole yen for JPY, cents for USD. Negative means owed or out.

amountMinor.description: The stored amount; null = not known yet (a one-off, or a monthly bill whose amount varies). A bill with no amount counts as an estimate from the household's earlier bills of the same name, or for nothing when there are none.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example JPY or USD.

due.description: The stored due date. A repeating bill is one row here, not one per month. Null = not known yet (a one-off only); it counts as due today.

category.description: One of the fourteen fixed categories; the key, not the label.

businessBp.description: The business share in basis points: 0 = personal, 10000 = business, between = mixed (3000 = 30% business). Categories and shares move no money.

status.description: pending = waiting in To check; it counts for nothing until the user confirms it.

anyOf.description: Integer minor units: whole yen for JPY, cents for USD. Negative means owed or out.

previousAmountMinor.description: Integer minor units: whole yen for JPY, cents for USD. Negative means owed or out.

anyOf.description: An exchange rate scaled by 1e6: units of the home currency per 1 USD, or original to billed currency.

fxRateMicro.description: An exchange rate scaled by 1e6: units of the home currency per 1 USD, or original to billed currency.

repeatDay.description: Day of the month a monthly bill falls due; null unless repeatUnit is month.

repeatUnit.description: month = every month on repeatDay, year = every year on the due date's month and day (29 Feb becomes 28 Feb in a common year); null or absent = one-off.

anyOf.description: Integer minor units: whole yen for JPY, cents for USD. Negative means owed or out.

nextAmountMinor.description: The amount an occurrence on or after nextAmountFrom costs, in the bill's currency; null or absent = the amount never changes. Set together with nextAmountFrom.

nextAmountFrom.description: The first date nextAmountMinor applies on.

cancelBy.description: Information only: the last day to cancel or change the bill before its next occurrence charges. The app never cancels anything.

repeatUntil.description: The last day an occurrence may fall on (the last payment); null or absent = it goes on. Only on a bill that repeats.

amountVaries.description: A monthly bill whose amount changes every month (electricity, water, gas): a month without its real bill is forecast as the average of the last three real bills linked to it (amountMinor when there are none). Absent = false.

seriesBillId.description: On a one-off real bill: the id of the amount-varies monthly bill it belongs to; it replaces that series' estimate in its due month. Null or absent = not linked.

madeBy.description: Who made the row: form = typed in or confirmed in the app, ask = the in-app assistant, mcp = a connected assistant, reader = read from a document, cron = the daily job, paypal = PayPal, import = an import.

bills.description: Stored rows. A repeating bill appears once, with `repeatUnit` (and `repeatDay` when monthly); occurrences are not expanded.

termsDays.description: Payment terms in days; 0 = due on receipt.

amountMinor.description: Integer minor units: whole yen for JPY, cents for USD. Negative means owed or out.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example JPY or USD.

anyOf.description: An exchange rate scaled by 1e6: units of the home currency per 1 USD, or original to billed currency.

fxRateMicro.description: Set when the payout was converted to the home currency.

paypalInvoiceId.description: null = typed in or marked paid outside PayPal.

madeBy.description: Who made the row: form = typed in or confirmed in the app, ask = the in-app assistant, mcp = a connected assistant, reader = read from a document, cron = the daily job, paypal = PayPal, import = an import.

anyOf.description: Integer minor units: whole yen for JPY, cents for USD. Negative means owed or out.

targetMinor.description: Integer minor units: whole yen for JPY, cents for USD. Negative means owed or out.

savedMinor.description: Set aside and not spendable once the pot is confirmed.

fillBp.description: Share of each client payment added to the pot, in basis points (2500 = 25%).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example JPY or USD.

status.description: pending = waiting in To check; it counts for nothing until the user confirms it.

madeBy.description: Who made the row: form = typed in or confirmed in the app, ask = the in-app assistant, mcp = a connected assistant, reader = read from a document, cron = the daily job, paypal = PayPal, import = an import.

amountMinor.description: In `currency`, always more than zero.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example JPY or USD.

through.description: Shared items dated on or before this day were settled, except those dated this day and created after `settledAt`; the next balance counts the rest.

settlements.description: Every transfer recorded by Mark settled, oldest first.

amountMinor.description: The new bank balance this update sets.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example JPY or USD.

status.description: confirmed = a balance the user set (history); pending = waiting in To check, the bank balance does not change until it is confirmed.

madeBy.description: Who made the row: form = typed in or confirmed in the app, ask = the in-app assistant, mcp = a connected assistant, reader = read from a document, cron = the daily job, paypal = PayPal, import = an import.

balanceUpdates.description: Bank balances set (confirmed) and waiting in To check (pending). Pending bills, charges and pots carry `status` in their own lists.

truncated.description: true = that list holds only its most recent rows because the reader asked for a window; the export is never truncated.

memory.description: What the assistant remembers (D58). Only in the export.
